bagPolicy.summary: All bags will be searched upon entry. Bags smaller than 6” x 9” x 2” are allowed, including clear bags.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking is available at the Cox Center parking garage, accessible from EK Gaylord. Additional parking options may be available nearby in downtown Oklahoma City and Bricktown.

rideshare.note: Uber/Lyft pickup and drop off point is at Second and Harvey, located on the west side of Paycom Center.

concessions.note: Paycom Center offers a variety of food and drink options including hot dogs, nachos, pizza, and specialty items like Big O's BBQ and Freddy's burgers. Beverage options include bottomless souvenir sodas, draft beers, and bottled water. Some stands may not be open during concerts and special events.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Paycom Center, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Paycom Center's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Paycom Center. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Paycom Center. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
